metadataReview.note: The Australian War Memorial dates the First Battle of Gaza to 26–27 March 1917. Add the supported second day to the catalogue’s existing 26 March opening. No change to equipment or quantities is implied. CDB90 row 326 remains on hold because its original Ottoman army identity and the scope of its 26000-person estimate are unresolved; matching these dates does not approve that numerical profile.
